name: Allison Stein
source: Part of the popular clique and Irene's childhood friend, sometimes known as "Alice." Allison seems to be a very polite and kind individual, which contrasts a bit with her friends. [spoiler]Her airheadedness is a ploy to hide her deep insecurities, but she secretly wishes for her friends to see her for who she truly is.
